source_semantics: Generate is disabled without content and while a generation is in flight.
Optional prompt, model, temperature, token budget, and tenant-owned site context are accepted.
The existing provider/model/secret/retry/usage/audit generation runtime is reused.
A structured reviewable suggestion is returned and displayed; no external content mutation or publication is performed.
Session suggestion history is local-only and bounded to ten entries.
Provider/model failures remain visible and never become false success.
